answer: A hostile operator running 179 aliases as a result needs 125 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are written down in shale, expire in garden, and walnut lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Scaling to 885 identities multiplies that fee by 244 with no matching gain in influence. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
